Egalin was the first summoner of a voidwalker into Azeroth. He detailed the process in his grimoire. The grimoire came into the hands of the Forsaken but was stolen by Captain Perrine of the Scarlet Crusade. Perrine was slain, and the grimoire delivered to Carendin Halgar, his pupil.

Edicts of the Prime Designate, Volume 742 is looted from an Ancient Volume in the Hall of the Keepers in Uldaman: Legacy of Tyr. It is a book that outlines three edicts from Prime Designate Odyn on interacting with the newly emerged mortals.

Two copies of Edict: The Healing Wings are found at in chambers of the Support Creche in the Forbidden Reach. One of them is at on the back wall in the northeastern room, and the other at is in the northwestern room.

It was developed by Eminence in partnership with Blizzard Entertainment. Einar Stonegrip was a level 20 quest giver located at the Dun Modr/Dun Algaz/Menethil Harbor crossroads in the Alliance-aligned territory of the Wetlands. He tasked adventurers with delivering a bundle of crocolisk skins to James Halloran. He was unwilling to do it himself, as he was on bad terms with his wife, Sida, and wished to put off facing her as long as possible. He is missing since Cataclysm, possibly having been killed when the Loch Modan dam broke.

Elder Torntusk is a forest troll quest giver located on the second floor of the inn at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands. Elder Torntusk personally fought in the Second War and fled to the coast of the Hinterlands after the war and helped established Revantusk Village. Sometime before the Revantusk joined the New Horde he was captured by the Vilebranch tribe and held at Jintha'Alor. After Horde adventurers freed him, by killing Hitah'ya the Keeper and securing the key she had, he returned to Revantusk Village. An Elder Charm of Good Fortune is a currency used to buy bonus rolls against the loot table of the patch 5.0.4 raid bosses in Pandaria. Champions in possession of any of these charms will, upon defeat of a raid boss, see an extra window appear beneath the other loot rolls, which gives them the chance to make an extra roll for loot from that boss. Elder charms appear in the currency tab and are limited to 20.

Elder Oakpaw is a pandaren profession trainer sitting outside the Laughing Crane in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle. Similarly to Whittler Dewei, he can train the player every profession in the game, to the usual limit of two.

The Elder Council (or the Council of Elders) is the ruling council of the Earthen Ring. Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff holds the governing Council of Elders. Following the Third War, the Earthen Ring had pure intentions towards the Forsaken and their entrance into the Horde, but there were some who wondered about the motivations of those whispering about it in the ears of the Elder Council. At the time of the Cataclysm, while Azeroth was in a chaotic state, the elements refused to answer the calls of the shaman, until the tauren Shotoa advocated for a more commanding role with the elements and to force them to obey. Eggs in One Basket is a quests achievement requiring the player to bring Arakkoa Outcasts with 100 morale to an Outcast Darkscryer in Skettis in Spires of Arak. The player must release 4 enslaved Arakkoa, at which point they will follow the player for 5 minutes until they despawn. Mobs must be killed to increase the morale of the Arakkoa, and when the bar reaches 100, they must be brought to a nearby Darkscryer.

She offers the opportunity to exchange the default orc guards for Darkspear trolls. She is only available to players after constructing a level 3 Barracks.

Egg Piles are found in Firelands. While in combat, they will spawn Smouldering Hatchlings.
Egrin the Defiler is an orc located at the Broken Horn Village in Gorgrond.
Elder Wendigo are wendigo creeps that can be encountered in the Northrend tileset.
Elder Incense is one of the items needed to create the Spirit Effigy, required to tame Gara.

El's Extreme Anglin was a World of Warcraft fansite, dedicated to fishing. The site was created by El, who is also referenced ingame as Salty El. The site has been down since May 2015, but an archived version still exists.
Eileen the Raven was a human located inside a cave in the Crescent Vale in Val'sharah. She began the vignette event that rewarded the toy Worn Doll.

Elderhorn Riding Harness is a crafted mount that summons the Great Northern Elderhorn. Once learned, the mount is account-wide and available to any character. As the item automatically binds to the crafter, it cannot be sold.
Eimear Noone is an Emmy Award winning composer who created music for Warcraft Franchise. Her spouse is Craig Stuart Garfinkle.
Elder Stonebrand is an earthen ghost located at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
Elder Menkhaf is a tol'vir ghost located at Khartut's Tomb in Uldum.
Elder Sekhemi is a tol'vir ghost located at the Ruins of Ammon in Uldum.
Elder Deepforge is an earthen ghost located at the Stonehearth in Deepholm.
Elder Darkfeather is an earthen ghost elder located in Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
Egyl the Enduring is a vrykul ghost located in the Cave of the Undying in Stormheim.
__NOTOC__ Elandris Bladesong is a night elven mage located in Bladesong's Retreat of Val'sharah. He is a part of the Adventurer of Val'sharah achievement.
Elder Sookh is a furbolg located in Val'sharah. He resolved to succeed Chieftain Graw as the chieftain of his tribe.
Elder Voidwalkers are voidwalker creeps that can be encountered in the Outland and Black Citadel tilesets.
Elder Hydras are hydra creeps that can be encountered in the Sunken Ruins tileset.
Elder Jungle Stalkers are jungle stalker creeps that can be encountered in the Sunken Ruins tileset.
Elder Sasquatch are sasquatch creeps that can be encountered in the Village and Village Fall tilesets.

Elder Watchers are wildkin that protected the Barrow Deeps during the Third War alongside Watchers troops. Ostensibly under the command of Maiev Shadowsong as well as the Keeper Califax, the Elders sought to bar Tyrande Whisperwind from the prison of Illidan Stormrage, imprisoned for ten thousand years by his brother Furion. They along with their commander were slain in the process of the Betrayer's liberation, a fact which amused Stormrage. Ultimately their charge was instrumental in delivering Azeroth from the Burning Legion's invasion.

Elder Aldera is an ancient located at the Emerald Dragonshrine in The Deaths of Chromie scenario. He has been having trouble sleeping due to the interference from Dream Tormentors, which attack him from the Emerald Nightmare. Past Chromie and an adventurer kill the tormentors and Aldera gives a clue as to who is behind this.
The Egg of Gaiath is provided as an objective for Return to Janai.
Egona Spangly is a gnome located in the Banquet Hall in Return to Karazhan. She and Peta Venkner have captured a Phantom Guest with their Ghost Traps.
Elder Spindlegrin is a giant remora located in Dread Wastes.

Elarian Sanctuary is the refuge of Eonar the Life-Binder, located on the world of Elunaria. The sanctuary is invaded by the Burning Legion during the raid on Antorus, the Burning Throne, but is defended by adventurers.
Elder Pindlefeather was a high arakkoa that guarded some ancient artifacts containing untold knowledge in Spires of Arak. It was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.
Elder Murk-Eye is a murloc located in the Lair of Harjatan in the Tomb of Sargeras. He is summoned by the Mrgrglhjorn for Grand Fin-ale. He is a call-back to Old Murk-Eye.
__NOTOC__ Elaine Clayton is a worgen located in Bear's Head in Azshara.
Elder Pterrorwings are skyscreamers located on the Isle of Thunder.

Eimear was the Queen of Ironforge, wife of King Magni Bronzebeard and mother of Princess Moira. After Moira's birth, Magni worried that something would take their daughter away from them. Eimear told him that if he spent his life worrying about the what-ifs, he would miss the things that really mattered. Years later, Eimear was mortally wounded by a group of Frostmane trolls near Ironforge. As she lay dying, she made Magni promise that whatever happened, he would be there for Moira. Eimear was put to rest in a stone tomb bearing her likeness. Afterward, Moira would sometimes visit the statue.
Eighteen and Over was an achievement earned by reaching Honor Prestige Level 18.
Elder Kuppaka is a tortollan quest giver located at the Tortaka Refuge in Vol'dun. He is the oldest and wisest member of the Tortaka tribe.

The Elder Bronze Dragon was a bronze dragon appearing in the Old Hatreds mission of the Founding of Durotar campaign. Thrall sent Rexxar to kill it and harvest a dragon scale in order to bless the Orgrimmar Battle Standard.
Elder Tae Swiftfoot is a pandaren located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Elder Sunset Crawlers are crabs located along the Sunset Shore in Talador.
__NOTOC__ Elder Mindbreakers are merciless ones located in the Shirakess Repository and the Gate of the Queen in Nazjatar.
Elderbranch is an Ancient of Lore located in Darkshore near Bashal'Aran during the Battle for Darkshore.
Ekka's Hideaway is found in the south western parts of the Nar'anan ruins in Nazjatar.
__NOTOC__ Elder Unu is the elder of the Kil'karrok makrura located at Kal'methir in Nazjatar.

Elder Voidcallers are voidcallers located at the Burial Fields in .
Eksis' Lair is a cave where Fathom-Commander Eksis leads his troops in secret. Alynblaze wants him dead for the death of many of his kin.
Elder Lake Creepers were bog beasts located in Silverpine Forest.
Elder Lake Skulkers were bog beasts located in Silverpine Forest.
Elder Finnan is a sylvar located at the Growthworks and Glitterfall Basin in Ardenweald.
